messages:
maria-cs: Crescent reporting intermittent 401s + short 429 bursts during SDK init in staging after an edge/WAF change. Ticket C-421.
liam-eng: Single host or many? Can you paste a minimal request example?
maria-cs: Single host. Sanitized request:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}
They see ~1/10 401s and bursty 429s (~30s windows).
zara-ps: Two likely culprits: proxy/WAF mutating or stripping Authorization header, or very short TTL + concurrent refresh causing stampede. TTL?
maria-cs: Token TTL is 15s, lots of pre-warmed serverless instances.
sam-sre: Short TTL + sync refresh = fanout of token requests -> rate spikes. Also proxies can drop Authorization -> 401. Ask them to add an X-Debug-Id and capture headers.
liam-eng: Quick probe to run:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug-Id:probe123" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"probe"}'
That shows if header arrives intact.
maria-cs: Sent. deploy-bot: deploy by liam-eng at 2026-03-21T09:12:00Z :rocket: 
maria-cs: Customer logs (tokens redacted):
[09:20:13Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe123 req=abc123
[09:20:13Z] 401 Unauthorized X-Debug-Id=probe124 req=abc124 auth=missing
[09:20:14Z] 429 Too Many Requests X-Debug-Id=probe125 req=abc125 rate=client_concurrency
[09:20:15Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe126 req=abc126
They report Authorization missing on some requests.
sam-sre: Sounds like WAF/proxy is stripping or truncating headers, or header-size limit hit. Any CDN/WAF in front?
maria-cs: Yes — they have a managed WAF and API gateway and they changed WAF rules just before failures.
liam-eng: If nginx is in the chain, ensure `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;`. Also check for header rewrite rules in WAF.
zara-ps: Short-term mitigation: increase token TTL to ~60s and add jitter to refresh to avoid synchronized bursts.
maria-cs: They disabled suspect WAF rule groups and retried: result = 10/10 200s; 429s almost gone after reducing concurrent refresh.
liam-eng: Recommended next steps: (1) fix WAF rule to forward Authorization unchanged, (2) raise TTL and add jitter for onboarding, (3) monitor and we can grant a temporary elevated rate window if needed.
zara-ps: I'll draft a short checklist for common gateways (nginx/envoy), token TTL guidance, and refresh jitter examples.
maria-cs: I'll update the ticket with mitigations and request their WAF post-mortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
